test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The solution is **Mechanicel**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelt word is Mechanicel.
 
• **Mechanical: **Operated by a machine or machinery.
 
 
• *For example: "A mechanical device."*
 
 
 
• **Mechanical **is an **Adjective **and a **Noun**.
 
• Medallion is a Noun.
 
• Meddle is a **Verb**.
 
• Mediate is an Adjective and a **Verb**.
 
• *​​*Therefore **option 3 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about other options:
 
 
• **Medallion - ** A piece of jewelry in the shape of a medal, worn as a pendant.

 
 
• *For example: "He wore a medallion after winning the race."*​
 
 
 
• **Meddle -** Interfere in something that is not one's concern. 
 
 
• *For example: "I don't want her meddling in our work." *​
 
 
 
• **Mediate - **Intervene in a dispute in order to bring about an agreement or reconciliation. 
 
 
• *For example: "Jack attempted to mediate between the power to end the fight."*​
